overview.en: This chapter summarizes four major developmental theories tested on NCLEX: Erikson (psychosocial), Piaget (cognitive), Kohlberg (moral) and Freud (psychosexual). Match each age group to its stage, task and appropriate nursing approach, and recognize when a finding is developmentally abnormal.
overview.zh: 本章整理 NCLEX 常考的四大發展理論：艾瑞克森（心理社會）、皮亞傑（認知）、柯爾伯格（道德）與佛洛伊德（心理性慾）。須將各年齡層對應其階段、任務與適當護理方式，並能辨識發展異常。

heading.zh: 艾瑞克森：心理社會發展

points.en: Eight stages from birth to death; each presents a crisis that must be resolved for emotional progress, though outcomes can be revised by later experience.
points.zh: 從出生到死亡共八個階段；每階段有一個危機，須解決才能情緒成長，但結果可被日後經驗改變。

points.en: Infancy (birth-18 mo): trust vs mistrust; attachment to caregiver. Respond to infant cues, hold and comfort.
points.zh: 嬰兒期（出生-18個月）：信任對不信任；與主要照顧者依附。回應嬰兒的訊號、擁抱與安撫。

points.en: Early childhood (18 mo-3 yr): autonomy vs shame and doubt; allow self-feeding, dressing and safe choices; set limits for tantrums with simple explanations.
points.zh: 幼兒期（18個月-3歲）：自主對羞愧懷疑；讓孩子自行進食、穿衣與在安全下做選擇；對發脾氣設限並簡單說明。

points.en: Late childhood (3-6 yr): initiative vs guilt; purposeful play, medical-equipment play.
points.zh: 學齡前期（3-6歲）：主動對罪惡感；有目的的遊戲、使用醫療器材玩具。

points.en: School age (6-12 yr): industry vs inferiority; learning and social skills; peers become important; continue schoolwork in hospital.
points.zh: 學齡期（6-12歲）：勤奮對自卑；學習與社交技能；同儕變重要；住院時持續課業。

points.en: Adolescence (12-20 yr): identity vs role confusion; allow choices and private interviews without parents.
points.zh: 青春期（12-20歲）：自我認同對角色混淆；讓其參與決定並可在無父母在場下會談。

points.en: Early adulthood (20-35): intimacy vs isolation. Middle adulthood (35-65): generativity vs stagnation. Later adulthood (65+): integrity vs despair; listen to reminiscence.
points.zh: 成年早期（20-35歲）：親密對孤立。成年中期（35-65歲）：生產對停滯。老年期（65歲以上）：完整對絕望；傾聽其回顧人生。

points.en: Schema is a mental framework; assimilation fits new information into existing schemas; accommodation changes the schema to fit new information.
points.zh: 基模是思考架構；同化是將新資訊納入既有基模；調適是改變基模以容納新資訊。

points.en: Sensorimotor (birth-2 yr): learns through senses and movement; object permanence develops (does not know hidden objects exist at first).
points.zh: 感覺動作期（出生-2歲）：透過感覺與動作學習；發展物體恆存概念（起初不知被遮物體仍存在）。

points.en: Preoperational (2-7 yr): prelogical, egocentric, needs concrete examples, thinks in past/present/future.
points.zh: 前運思期（2-7歲）：前邏輯思考、自我中心、需要具體例子，開始有過去、現在、未來概念。

points.en: Concrete operational (7-11 yr): classifies, orders, sorts; logical about concrete problems; less egocentric.
points.zh: 具體運思期（7-11歲）：分類、排序、歸納；對具體問題有邏輯；較不自我中心。

points.en: Formal operational (11 yr to adulthood): abstract and logical thinking like an adult.
points.zh: 形式運思期（11歲至成年）：如成人般抽象與邏輯思考。

points.en: A 6-year-old who lacks object permanence is abnormal: report to the pediatrician.
points.zh: 6歲兒童缺乏物體恆存屬異常：應通報小兒科醫師。

points.en: Moral development is sequential; stages cannot be skipped; it follows cognitive development; not everyone reaches stages 5-6.
points.zh: 道德發展依序進行，不可跳階；隨認知發展而進展；並非人人達到第5-6階段。

points.en: Preconventional: stage 1 punishment-obedience (2-4 yr), stage 2 instrumental relativist, 'what is in it for me' (4-7 yr). Motivated by punishment and reward.
points.zh: 前習俗層次：第1階段懲罰與服從（2-4歲），第2階段工具相對（「我有什麼好處」）（4-7歲）。動機來自懲罰與獎賞。

points.en: Conventional: stage 3 good boy/nice girl (7-10 yr) to please others; stage 4 law and order (10-12 yr).
points.zh: 習俗層次：第3階段乖男孩／好女孩（7-10歲），為取悅他人；第4階段法律與秩序（10-12歲）。

points.en: Postconventional (about age 13+): stage 5 social contract; stage 6 universal ethical principles; internal conscience.
points.zh: 後習俗層次（約13歲後）：第5階段社會契約；第6階段普遍倫理原則；內在良知。

points.en: Toddler discipline: simple explanations, praise good behavior, distraction; avoid physical punishment or withdrawing love.
points.zh: 幼兒管教：簡單說明、稱讚良好行為、轉移注意；避免體罰或收回關愛。

heading.en: Freud: Levels of Awareness and Personality
heading.zh: 佛洛伊德：意識層次與人格結構

points.en: Unconscious: illogical, pleasure principle, repressed material. Preconscious: recallable. Conscious: logical, reality principle.
points.zh: 潛意識：不合邏輯、享樂原則、壓抑的內容。前意識：可回憶。意識：合邏輯、現實原則。

points.en: Id: drives, pleasure principle, present at birth, impulsive. Ego: reality testing and problem solving, mediates between id and world, starts about 4-5 months. Superego: conscience and ego ideal, develops in phallic stage (3-6 yr).
points.zh: 本我：驅力、享樂原則、出生即有、衝動。自我：現實檢驗與解決問題、調節本我與外界，約4-5個月開始形成。超我：良知與自我理想，於性器期（3-6歲）發展。

points.en: Defense mechanisms are mostly unconscious (except suppression) and distort reality to reduce anxiety; needed for survival but extreme use hinders adjustment.
points.zh: 防衛機轉多為無意識（壓抑除外），扭曲現實以減少焦慮；為生存所必需，但過度使用妨礙適應。

points.en: Oral (birth-1 yr): gratification through mouth; trust begins; ego emerges.
points.zh: 口腔期（出生-1歲）：以口腔獲得滿足；信任開始；自我萌芽。

points.en: Anal (1-3 yr): toilet training and control of body; learning to delay gratification.
points.zh: 肛門期（1-3歲）：如廁訓練與身體控制；學習延遲滿足。

points.en: Phallic (3-6 yr): genital focus, Oedipus complex, identification with same-sex parent; superego emerges.
points.zh: 性器期（3-6歲）：注意生殖器、戀母情結、認同同性父母；超我出現。

points.en: Latency (6-12 yr): sexual urges quiet; energy goes to school, friends and skills.
points.zh: 潛伏期（6-12歲）：性衝動沉寂；精力投入學業、友誼與技能。

points.en: Genital (12+): puberty, mature sexual and emotional relationships, life goals and identity.
points.zh: 兩性期／生殖期（12歲以上）：青春期、成熟的性與情感關係、人生目標與認同。

points.en: Each stage has a conflict to resolve; early experiences shape adult personality.
points.zh: 每階段有需解決的衝突；早期經驗形塑成人人格。

critical_points.en: Infant: trust vs mistrust; respond promptly and consistently to the infant's signals.
critical_points.zh: 嬰兒：信任對不信任；對嬰兒訊號迅速且一致地回應。

critical_points.en: Toddler: autonomy vs shame/doubt; allow safe choices, set limits on tantrums with simple explanations.
critical_points.zh: 幼兒：自主對羞愧懷疑；給予安全選擇，對發脾氣設限並簡單說明。

critical_points.en: Preschooler: initiative vs guilt; encourage purposeful, imaginative play.
critical_points.zh: 學齡前：主動對罪惡感；鼓勵有目的與想像的遊戲。

critical_points.en: School-age: industry vs inferiority; peer focus is normal and healthy.
critical_points.zh: 學齡兒童：勤奮對自卑；注重同儕是正常且健康的。

critical_points.en: Adolescent: identity vs role confusion; interview privately and include in decisions.
critical_points.zh: 青少年：認同對角色混淆；私下會談並納入決策。

critical_points.en: Older adult: integrity vs despair; listen to life reminiscence.
critical_points.zh: 老年人：完整對絕望；傾聽生命回顧。
皮亞傑：感覺動作期0-2、前運思期2-7、具體運思期7-11、形式運思期11歲以上。

critical_points.en: A school-age child without object permanence is developmentally delayed: report to the provider.
critical_points.zh: 學齡兒童缺乏物體恆存為發展遲緩：通報醫師。

critical_points.en: Preconventional morality is driven by punishment and reward.
critical_points.zh: 前習俗道德以懲罰與獎賞為動機。

critical_points.en: Kohlberg stages are sequential and cannot be skipped; preschoolers are preconventional, school-age conventional, adolescents postconventional.
critical_points.zh: 柯爾伯格階段依序、不可跳階；學齡前為前習俗、學齡期為習俗、青少年進入後習俗。

critical_points.en: Freud: anal stage = toilet training (1-3 yr); phallic = identification with same-sex parent; latency = sexual repression; oral = mouth gratification.
critical_points.zh: 佛洛伊德：肛門期＝如廁訓練（1-3歲）；性器期＝認同同性父母；潛伏期＝性衝動壓抑；口腔期＝口腔滿足。

critical_points.en: Id = pleasure principle, ego = reality principle, superego = conscience.
critical_points.zh: 本我＝享樂原則；自我＝現實原則；超我＝良知。

critical_points.en: Defense mechanisms are unconscious except suppression.
critical_points.zh: 防衛機轉為無意識，唯壓抑（suppression）為有意識。

critical_points.en: Do not use physical punishment or withdraw love with toddlers; use explanation, praise and distraction.
critical_points.zh: 對幼兒勿用體罰或收回關愛；用說明、稱讚與轉移注意力。

mnemonics.en: Erikson in order: Trust, Autonomy, Initiative, Industry, Identity, Intimacy, Generativity, Integrity (TAI-III-GI).
mnemonics.zh: 艾瑞克森順序：信任、自主、主動、勤奮、認同、親密、生產、完整。
皮亞傑：感覺動作、前運思、具體運思、形式運思（S-P-C-F）。

mnemonics.en: Freud: Oral, Anal, Phallic, Latency, Genital (OAPLG).
mnemonics.zh: 佛洛伊德：口腔、肛門、性器、潛伏、兩性（OAPLG）。
柯爾伯格：前習俗（懲罰／獎賞）、習俗（取悅他人／法律）、後習俗（原則）。

stem.en: According to Kohlberg, what motivates good and bad actions in a child at the preconventional level?
stem.zh: 依柯爾伯格理論，前習俗層次的兒童以何種因素決定行為好壞？

rationale.en: At the preconventional level morality is motivated by punishment and reward.
rationale.zh: 前習俗層次的道德以懲罰與獎賞為動機。

source.title: Original practice question based on the chapter

stem.en: Using Erikson's theory, what should the nurse teach new parents about their newborn?
stem.zh: 依艾瑞克森理論，護理師應教導新手父母如何對待新生兒？

options.en: Allow the infant to signal needs and respond consistently
options.zh: 讓嬰兒表達需求並一致地回應

options.en: Anticipate every need before the infant signals
options.zh: 在嬰兒表達前預先滿足所有需求

options.en: Ignore crying for the first 10 minutes
Feed on a strict rigid schedule only
options.zh: 只依嚴格固定時間表餵食

rationale.en: Responding to signals teaches the infant they can influence the world, building trust. Delayed responses lead to mistrust.
rationale.zh: 回應訊號使嬰兒學會能影響環境，建立信任；延遲回應導致不信任。

source.title: Original practice question based on the chapter

stem.en: A 6-year-old does not realize objects exist when out of sight. What does the nurse do?
stem.zh: 6歲兒童不知物體離開視線後仍存在。護理師應怎麼做？

options.en: Keep objects in the child's direct view
options.zh: 將物品放在孩子視線內

rationale.en: Lack of object permanence is expected in infancy but abnormal at 6; it needs medical follow-up.
rationale.zh: 缺乏物體恆存在嬰兒期屬正常，6歲則異常，需醫療追蹤。

source.title: Original practice question based on the chapter

stem.en: Which characteristic relates to Freud's anal stage?
stem.zh: 哪項特徵屬於佛洛伊德的肛門期？

rationale.en: Anal stage (1-3 yr) centers on control of elimination. Oral = mouth; latency = repression; phallic = identification.
rationale.zh: 肛門期（1-3歲）以排泄控制為核心；口腔期為口腔、潛伏期為壓抑、性器期為認同。

source.title: Original practice question based on the chapter

stem.en: Which behavior is characteristic of Piaget's formal operations stage?
stem.zh: 哪種行為是皮亞傑形式運思期的特徵？

options.en: Thinks abstractly and solves problems like an adult
options.zh: 如成人般抽象思考與解決問題

options.en: Understands objects that are no longer visible
options.zh: 理解看不見的物體仍存在

rationale.en: Formal operations (11 years onward) allow abstract, logical thought. The others describe preoperational, sensorimotor, and concrete operational stages.
rationale.zh: 形式運思期（11歲起）可抽象邏輯思考；其他選項分別是前運思、感覺動作與具體運思期。

source.title: Original practice question based on the chapter

stem.en: A parent worries that an 8-year-old cares more about friends than anything else. Which response reflects Erikson's theory?
stem.zh: 家長擔心8歲孩子最在意朋友。哪個回應符合艾瑞克森理論？

options.en: At this age children are developing their own personalities
options.zh: 這個年紀的孩子正在發展自己的個性

options.en: Give more praise to stop this
options.zh: 多稱讚以停止這種行為

rationale.en: School-age children turn toward peers and develop their own interests (industry vs inferiority); this is normal.
rationale.zh: 學齡兒童轉向同儕並發展自己的興趣（勤奮對自卑），屬正常。

source.title: Original practice question based on the chapter

stem.en: Which statements about Kohlberg's theory are correct? Select all that apply.
stem.zh: 關於柯爾伯格理論，哪些正確？（複選）

options.zh: 道德發展與認知發展並行

options.en: Stage 1 children reason like mature members of society
options.zh: 第1階段兒童像成熟社會成員般推理

options.en: In stage 2 the child follows rules to gain rewards
options.zh: 第2階段兒童遵守規則以獲取獎賞
每個人都會達到第6階段

rationale.en: Not everyone reaches stages 5-6, and stage 1 children cannot reason as mature members of society.
rationale.zh: 並非人人達到第5-6階段，且第1階段兒童無法像成熟社會成員般推理。

source.title: Original practice question based on the chapter

stem.en: Which nursing action best supports an adolescent's task of identity development during hospitalization?
stem.zh: 住院期間，哪項護理措施最能支持青少年的認同發展？

options.en: Perform the history and examination without parents present and allow choices in care
options.zh: 在家長不在場下做病史與檢查，並讓其參與照護決定

options.en: Make all decisions for the adolescent
Require parents to answer all questions
options.zh: 要求家長回答所有問題

rationale.en: Autonomy and privacy support identity vs role confusion.
rationale.zh: 自主與隱私支持「認同對角色混淆」的任務。
